title: Oven Roasted Russian Pork Shoulder Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring pork shoulder, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is egg-free and features a crispy crust on the pork.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika.
Rub the mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork shoulder in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, arranging them around the pork shoulder.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the pork and vegetables for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Continue roasting for an additional 90 minutes, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
